patterns.name: repeated_login_failures_same_source
patterns.condition: Within a short time window, repeated login failures originate from the same source address.
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1110 describes brute force attempts that repeatedly try credentials to gain access.

patterns.name: password_spraying_across_accounts
patterns.condition: The same source address attempts authentication against multiple accounts using a shared candidate password.
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1110.003 (Password Spraying) describes trying a password or small set of passwords against many accounts.
